cc:Work.dc:title: Moosefather versus mountain lion
cc:Work.dc:description: In a scene with a mountainous backdrop a bull moose with large palmate antlers faces off against a mountain lion baring its teeth while a smaller moose stands behind them. This image is from a 1921 magazine advertisement for Piso's opiate-free cough syrup: https://hdl.handle.net/2027/mdp.39015068416422?urlappend=%3Bseq=68
